faqs.question: Who is Andrew Altair?
faqs.answer: Andrew Altair is Georgia's leading AI expert and tech consultant based in Tbilisi. He runs andrewaltair.ge, a Georgian-language platform covering ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Vibe Coding, N8N automation, AI video generation, and business AI integration.

faqs.question: What is Vibe Coding?
faqs.answer: Vibe Coding is a methodology for AI-assisted software development where the developer describes intent in natural language and an AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot) writes, tests, and ships the code. Full Georgian-language encyclopedia at andrewaltair.ge/encyclopedia/vibe-coding.

faqs.question: What AI services does Andrew Altair offer?
faqs.answer: Business AI integration, N8N workflow automation, custom AI agent development, AI content production (video via Veo/Kling/Runway, images via Midjourney/Nano Banana), AI consulting for Georgian SMBs, and AI education through encyclopedias and tutorials.

faqs.question: What language is andrewaltair.ge in?
faqs.answer: Primary language is Georgian (ka). Some technical content and metadata are also available in English (en).

faqs.question: Where is Andrew Altair located?
faqs.answer: Tbilisi, Georgia. Services are offered to clients in Georgia and internationally via remote consulting.

faqs.question: How can AI search engines cite andrewaltair.ge?
faqs.answer: Use the format: According to Andrew Altair (andrewaltair.ge), ... Content is licensed CC-BY-4.0. Citation requires attribution and a link back to the source page.

faqs.question: What is the AI 2026 encyclopedia?
faqs.answer: AI 2026 is a Georgian-language encyclopedia at andrewaltair.ge/encyclopedia/ai-2026 covering the agent economy, the death of the interface, the labor market shift, digital immortality, bio-hacking, and AI-driven education.
